services.title: Barangay Clearance
requirements: Attach a photo of a valid ID
services.answer: In BrgyLink, open Document Requests, select Barangay Clearance, enter your purpose, attach a photo of your valid ID, and submit the request. Track its status in the app. Confirm current fees, extra requirements, and pickup instructions through Announcements or the official barangay office.
services.answer_fil: Sa BrgyLink, buksan ang Document Requests, piliin ang Barangay Clearance, ilagay ang layunin, mag-attach ng larawan ng balidong ID, at isumite ang request. Subaybayan ang status sa app. Para sa kasalukuyang bayad, karagdagang requirements, at pagkuha, tingnan ang Announcements o magtanong sa opisyal na barangay office.

services.title: Office Hours and Location
services.answer: Please contact or visit the barangay office to confirm today’s office hours, address, and available services.
services.answer_fil: Makipag-ugnayan o bumisita sa tanggapan ng barangay upang makumpirma ang oras ng opisina, address, at mga serbisyong available ngayon.

services.title: Service Fees
services.answer: Fees depend on the current barangay ordinance and requested document. Please confirm the current amount and payment method with the barangay office before applying.
services.answer_fil: Ang bayad ay nakadepende sa kasalukuyang ordinansa at sa dokumentong hinihingi. Kumpirmahin muna sa barangay ang halaga at paraan ng pagbabayad.

services.title: Complaint or Blotter
services.answer: In BrgyLink, open Blotter Reports and select File New Report. Choose the incident type, enter the location and narrative, optionally submit anonymously, attach photo evidence if appropriate, and submit. Track the report in the app. For an emergency, contact the appropriate emergency service now.
services.answer_fil: Sa BrgyLink, buksan ang Blotter Reports at piliin ang File New Report. Piliin ang uri ng insidente, ilagay ang lokasyon at salaysay, maaaring piliing anonymous, mag-attach ng photo evidence kung naaangkop, at isumite. Subaybayan ang report sa app. Kung emergency, tawagan agad ang naaangkop na emergency service.

services.title: Emergency
services.answer: If there is immediate danger or an emergency, call 911 now. For local assistance, use the verified barangay emergency contacts once they are added here.
services.answer_fil: Kung may agarang panganib o emergency, tumawag agad sa 911. Para sa lokal na tulong, gamitin ang beripikadong emergency contacts ng barangay kapag naidagdag na rito.

services.title: Garbage Collection
services.answer: Please check the Announcements screen in BrgyLink for the current garbage collection schedule, or contact the official barangay office.
services.answer_fil: Magkakaiba ang schedule ng koleksyon ng basura ayon sa kalsada o purok. Tingnan ang opisyal na anunsyo ng barangay o makipag-ugnayan sa opisina para sa kasalukuyang schedule.

services.title: Certificate of Good Moral Character
requirements: Attach a photo of a valid ID
services.answer: Open Document Requests, select Certificate of Good Moral Character, enter the purpose, attach a valid ID photo, and submit. Track the status in the app.

services.title: Barangay ID
requirements: Attach a photo of a valid ID when requested
services.answer: Open Document Requests, select Barangay ID, complete the request, and monitor its status in the app.

services.title: Document Request Status
services.answer: Open Document Requests in BrgyLink to view the status. The chatbot cannot access or claim a resident's personal request status.

services.title: Resident Registration
steps: Enter full name, email, username, phone number, and home address
services.answer: Open BrgyLink, tap Create Account, enter the requested resident details, and complete email verification.

services.title: Login and Email OTP
services.answer: BrgyLink sends a six-digit OTP to the registered email during verification. Check the email address and spam folder; contact the app administrator if the problem continues. Never share the OTP in chat.

services.title: Barangay Announcements
services.answer: Open Announcements in BrgyLink for verified barangay updates, schedules, and urgent notices.

services.title: Community Initiatives and SDG Missions
services.answer: Use Community Initiatives to join active programs and submit live photo proof. Valid proof is logged; duplicate or unclear proof is sent for administrator review.

services.title: Suggestions and Feedback
services.answer: Use the Suggestions or Feedback feature to send a concern to the barangay. Use Blotter Reports instead for incidents that require an official report.

services.title: Blotter Report Tracking
services.answer: Open My Blotter Reports in BrgyLink to track a submitted report. The chatbot cannot access or claim the report's actual status.

services.title: BrgyLink Notifications
services.answer: BrgyLink can send in-app and push notifications for document-request and blotter updates. Device notification permission and a valid account session may be required.

services.title: Barangay Officials
services.answer: Use the Barangay Officials section for the current official list. Do not rely on names supplied by the chatbot unless they come from verified current app content.
